content_sections.heading: Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Sainik School Satara, functioning under the Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence, New Delhi, has released the Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026 notification for recruitment to 7 different posts, including Medical Officer, Counsellor, Riding Instructor, Quarter Master, Ward Boy, PEM/PTI cum Matron and Nursing Sister. A total of 8 vacancies have been announced, including 2 vacancies for Ward Boy and 1 vacancy each for the remaining posts. The applications are invited through offline mode by Post or by Hand only, and the completed application must reach Sainik School Satara on or before 09 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Sainik School Satara Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The Sainik School Satara Vacancy 2026 is spread across 7 posts, all unreserved (UR) except where noted, with a combined total of 8 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Satara Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026 is different for each post. Candidates should check the qualification and desirable criteria for their post of interest before applying, as the essential conditions below are specific to each role. Desirable qualifications (such as additional certifications, prior experience in a residential school, sports/art/music attainments, and computer knowledge) vary by post and are mentioned separately for each role in the official notification; these are not compulsory requirements.

rows.essential_qualification: MBBS degree; must attend the school dispensary at least 5 days a week for at least 2 hours each day; must reside within a reasonable distance (about 5 kms) from the school and be available on telephone for emergencies

Graduate/Post Graduate in Psychology with at least 50% marks, OR Post Graduate in Child Development with at least 50% marks, OR Graduate/Post Graduate with Diploma in Career Guidance and Counselling with at least 50% marks

Matriculation; experience in horse management including stable maintenance, health and hygiene, first aid of horses, and equestrian sports; ability to teach and train students in horse riding; required to stay on the school campus
B.A./B.Com with at least 5 years experience as UDC stores or as Quartermaster, or an ex-serviceman (preferably a JCO) with at least 10 years experience in handling and accounting of stores
Passed Matriculation or equivalent examination and able to converse fluently in English
Passed Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized Board and able to converse fluently in English; required to stay in the Girls Hostel accommodation
Nursing diploma/degree with 5 years experience, or an ex-serviceman of the Medical Assistant trade with at least 5 years of service after training; required to stay in the school campus

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Satara Age Limit
content_sections.text: For all 7 posts under Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026, the age limit is between 18 and 50 years as on 09 October 2026. Age relaxation may be considered for ex-servicemen as per Government rules. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Satara Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification states that shortlisted candidates will be sent call letters by e-mail or post, indicating the date, venue and type of examination. The venue of examination is Sainik School Satara. Detailed selection stages (such as written test, skill test, or interview) are not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format from the official school website, www.sainiksatara.org. Fill in the application form completely and attach self-attested copies of educational qualification and experience certificates. Affix a passport-size photograph and superscribe the name of the post applied for on the envelope. Enclose one self-addressed envelope (9"x4") with Rs. 56/- postage stamps affixed. For General and OBC candidates, enclose an A/c payee Demand Draft of Rs. 250/- (non-refundable) drawn in favour of "Principal, Sainik School Satara", payable at Satara. SC/ST candidates are exempt from the fee. OBC/SC/ST candidates should also attach a copy of their Caste Certificate; OBC candidates must submit an NCL Certificate. Send the completed application along with all required documents by Post or by Hand to: Principal, Sainik School Satara, Satara-415001, Maharashtra, so that it reaches on or before 09 October 2026. A separate application is required for each post applied for. Applications sent by e-mail will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Satara Apply Online
content_sections.text: Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026 does not have an online application process. Applications must be submitted offline, by post or by hand, using the prescribed format available on www.sainiksatara.org. Applications sent by e-mail will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application form with self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Self-attested copies of experience certificates Demand Draft (for General/OBC candidates only) One self-addressed envelope (9"x4") with Rs. 56/- postage stamps affixed Photocopy of ID proof (Aadhar Card/Driving Licence/PAN Card/Voter ID) Caste Certificate (for OBC/SC/ST candidates) and NCL Certificate (for OBC candidates)

content_sections.heading: Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The school will not be responsible for postal delays. Only Indian Nationals can apply. Incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected. No TA/DA will be admissible for the interview/examination. The school administration reserves the right to modify or cancel the vacancy due to non-availability of suitable candidates, or for administrative or policy reasons.

faq.question: Q1. What is Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Sainik School Satara, functioning under the Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence, to fill 8 contractual vacancies across 7 posts: Medical Officer, Counsellor, Riding Instructor, Quarter Master, Ward Boy, PEM/PTI cum Matron, and Nursing Sister.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies in total across 7 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the application along with relevant documents and Demand Draft to reach the Principal, Sainik School Satara is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements differ by post, ranging from Matriculation (Riding Instructor, Ward Boy, PEM/PTI cum Matron) to graduate/postgraduate degrees or diplomas (Counsellor, Quarter Master) and professional degrees (MBBS for Medical Officer, Nursing diploma/degree for Nursing Sister).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between 18 and 50 years as on 09 October 2026, with age relaxation for ex-servicemen as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Sainik School Satara Recruitment 2026?

faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline by downloading the prescribed application format from www.sainiksatara.org and sending it, along with required documents, by Post or by Hand to the Principal, Sainik School Satara, Satara-415001, Maharashtra. Applications by e-mail are not accepted.
